result.title: Empowering Masked Diffusion Models to Self-Correct with Leave-One-Out Transformers
result.summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for language modeling, enabling parallel token generation with competitive performance. Yet standard MDMs suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) inability to revise tokens, and (2) sparse training signal. We revisit hollow transformers, which address both limitations by predicting each token from its surrounding context, independently of the input at that position. We introduce the Leave-One-Out Transformer (LOOT), a more efficient and expressive architecture that advances hollow transformers through two complementary advances. First, we redesign the merging mechanism to enable frequent interaction between left and right contexts, substantially improving predictive performance over prior hollow transformers. Second, we derive a lower-variance estimator of the MDM NELBO that supervises all tokens and improves validation perplexity. Together, these advances yield a competitive standalone diffusion language model capable of effective self-correction during inference. On LM1B, LOOT matches the strongest dense-supervision MDM baseline in validation perplexity. On OpenWebText, LOOT achieves higher MAUVE and better generation quality-diversity tradeoffs than prior remasking methods, using $8\times$ fewer forward evaluations and $3.5\times$ fewer inference FLOPs.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Leave-One-Out Transformer（LOOT），改进 hollow transformer 的左右上下文合并机制，并给出低方差的 MDM NELBO 估计以监督全部 token，使纯文本掩码扩散模型具备推理期自我纠错能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽为纯文本扩散生成，但其「由上下文预测某位置、与输入无关」的独立预测与推理期逐 token 修正，可能为 latent 状态的迭代更新、视觉旁路下的信息坍缩诊断及全 token 监督的贡献分配提供可供核查的线索。
